nom: Urban Hydration Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Leaf Face Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed but mostly positive results: several say the wash cleanses without over-drying or stripping and even reduces shine through the day, while a couple report no real change in their oil levels.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin, including some with eczema, report the wash hydrates and reduces flaking without stripping, though a couple with dry or combination skin found it dried their skin out badly.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mostly calming, non-drying results that help both oily and dry areas, though one reviewer with an oily T-zone found it dried her skin out all over.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some managing medication-related dryness, report the wash is gentle and non-irritating, but a minority, including some who say they don't normally react to washes, describe burning, rashes or red marks.
segments.normal: One reviewer explicitly describes it as a great basic wash for normal skin with no increase in breakouts, while two others who say they do not have sensitive skin report unexpected burning and irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report the wash leaves their skin smooth and hydrated and helps with mild adult acne, with one crediting it, as part of a wider routine, for finally improving long-standing dullness and uneven texture.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the wash as hydrating or at least non-drying, including several with dry or eczema-prone skin who say it does not strip their skin; a couple of reviewers, including one with combination skin, report it dried their skin out badly.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers, including some with rosacea or eczema, report visibly reduced redness with continued use; one reviewer who does not normally have sensitive skin reports the wash left red marks and a burning sensation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports the wash cleanses without damaging her skin barrier or stripping it, and several others similarly describe it as non-stripping.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report fading of dark spots and post-acne marks after a couple of weeks of use; one reviewer's experience was mixed, noting it helped some hyperpigmentation but not her older, more established dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts or reduced acne with continued use, including some with cystic or hormonal acne; dissent comes from a couple of reviewers who saw no real change in their acne after several weeks.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers report the wash controls oil through the day or does not add oiliness, while others with oily skin report no noticeable change in their oil levels.

extraits.texte: I do not have sensitive skin and have never had a reaction to anything until this face wash. It felt like it was burning my skin and left red marks in spots.

Foams up nicely and smells pleasant but leaves skin feeling very dry. I have combination skin, which tends to be oily through the T-zone and it really dried my skin out all over. It also takes quite a bit of rinsing to get it all removed.

I have been using this face wash for about a month now and I simply do not see much difference in my skin. The cleansing aspect is good, just about what you would expect from any face wash, but it did not significantly affect any blemishes or oil level. I have always had oily skin and I was hoping this product would affect the oil levels of my face, but it did not. The face wash does smell nice. I also was not a huge fan of the consistency as it is a little too watery compared to most face washes.

extraits.titre: Rosacea and break outs cleared up
extraits.texte: I have oily skin and large pores as well as rosacea flair ups. This is one of the best face washes I've tried for my skin. I've tried many over the years. Pores look better, it's gentle and reduces the redness. A lot less pimples.

extraits.titre: Great for my eczema prone skin!
extraits.texte: I recently received this aloe face wash by Urban Hydration and was pleasantly surprised how well it helped to reduce the signs of my facial eczema. Over the past few years, I have been dealing with extremely dry and scaly skin on my face as a result of my eczema. I have felt hopeless at times that I would never find a product that worked well at reducing or eliminating this issue. I believe this face wash is finally the product I have been seeking. It is so simple and easy to apply and I noticed results in only a couple days. After 2 weeks of using this product once a day, my skin has felt moisturized and the redness has been nearly eliminated. My confidence has increased so much and I no longer get anxiety thinking that people are staring at my skin. Even better, this company gives back to the community. If you are an individual who suffers from eczema symptoms on your face then this is the product for you and I would highly recommend it.
This stuff is not only good for acne but has definitely helped with fading dark spots and post acne redness. I'm obsessed with it!!

I spent enough on my order to get one of those free 30 piece sampler sets and this came in it. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and the medication I'm on dries it out so much. This was such a nice product to use and didn't make my skin flare up. Price is amazing too. I like to lather mine in my hands until it turns foamy and white before I rub it onto my face!
